build_efficientnet_model: build an EfficientNet model for ImageNet classification using configurable stages, heads, and activation functions
create_mbconv_block: create an MBConv mobile inverted bottleneck block with SE attention and depthwise convolution
create_mbtalkconv_block: create an MBTalkConv block that replaces standard convolutions with graph-based TalkConv2d layers
create_efficientnet_head: create a ConvHead, LinearHead, or SimpleHead classification head for the EfficientNet model
apply_drop_connect: apply drop connect regularization to skip connections using TensorFlow or PyTorch implementation
